implementation.sourceOfTruth: The fullgame campaign manifest authors the runtime catalog. Its explicit authoringSpecSources point to exact imported copies under content/campaigns/urman.fullgame/photoworlds-sources; the ContentCompiler validates these compile-time inputs then strips their paths. No station-time docs lookup or runtime docs dependency exists.
implementation.typedCatalog: Urman.Core.Narrative.PhotoWorldCatalog parses the compiled catalog and enforces 13 unique PhotoIds/PageIds, five worlds, one primary photo per world, unique authored nodes/resources, main-spawn and exit role references, and inclusion of all five world anchors in the existing required-anchor list.
implementation.compilerValidation: ContentCompiler cross-checks campaign IDs, world-photo mappings, anchors, spawn/exit node IDs and roles, all node IDs/roles, and each required resource ID against explicit v1 spec sources. It rejects missing and unknown records instead of creating defaults.
implementation.assetBoundary: assets.spec.json is treated as a requirement register only. Its current 48 records are REQUESTED / NOT_RUN / REQUIRES_PROVENANCE; no runtime asset availability or production readiness is claimed.
implementation.physicalBoundary: Spawn and exit fields are authored logical node references. No physical safe-node, collision, scene materialization, transition, teleport, or runtime-world readiness is certified. PhotoWorldState schema and world-ID owner were not changed.

catalog.pageIdMapping: All 13 existing stable PageId values were preserved; the photos spec does not define a separate PageId field.
